review_description: From the initial inquiry through to the completion of installation, everything was done to my complete satisfaction. I found Myers to be friendly and helpful as well as efficient. I have no hesitation in giving them the highest approval rating.
Sales/quoting process brilliant.  The came to our property and explained where everything would go.

Myers Solar were fantastic to deal with and made me feel confident about the whole process.  From the initial discussion it was so easy as they kept me informed of each step and sent me forms and information at each stage as required. Any queries I had were dealt with promptly and pleasantly by the office. The installers were punctual, respectful and cleaned up after the works. The electrician Rob was a great communicator.  This company is a well oiled machine and really know their business.
From the first home visit, to the local knowledge, to installation and beyond, Myers Solar has provided us with excellent service, resulting in a smooth and satisfying solar installation experience.
